entries.title: Job 18:1
segments: And Bildad the Shuhite answered and said,

entries.title: Job 18:2
segments: Until when will you set a snare for words? Understand, and afterwards we will speak.

entries.title: Job 18:3
segments: Why are we counted as cattle, or seem stupid in your sight?

entries.title: Job 18:4
segments: He tears himself in his anger; [shall] the earth [be] forsaken for you? And shall the rock be moved out of its place?

entries.title: Job 18:5
segments: Yes, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

entries.title: Job 18:6
segments: The light shall be dark in his tent, and his lamp shall be put out with him.

entries.title: Job 18:7
segments: The steps of his strength shall be hampered, and his own plans shall throw him down.

entries.title: Job 18:8
segments: For he is thrown into a net by his own feet, and he walks on a net.

entries.title: Job 18:9
segments: The trap shall take [him] by the heel, and the noose shall hold sway over him.

entries.title: Job 18:10
segments: The pitfall [is] laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

entries.title: Job 18:11
segments: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall dash him at his feet.

entries.title: Job 18:12
segments: His strength shall be hunger-bitten, and trouble shall be ready at his side.

entries.title: Job 18:13
segments: It shall devour the parts of his skin; the first-born of death consumes his parts.

entries.title: Job 18:14
segments: His hope shall be rooted out of his tent, and you marched to the king of terrors.

entries.title: Job 18:15
segments: What [is] not his shall dwell in his tent; brimstone shall be scattered on his home.

entries.title: Job 18:16
segments: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and his branch shall wither above.

entries.title: Job 18:17
segments: His memory shall perish from the earth, and there is no name to him on the face of the street.

entries.title: Job 18:18
segments: They drive him from light to darkness, and they make him flee from the world.

entries.title: Job 18:19
segments: He shall have neither son nor kinsman among his people, nor [any] remaining in his dwellings.

entries.title: Job 18:20
segments: Those after him shall be amazed at his day; and those before were seized [with] horror.

entries.title: Job 18:21
segments: Surely these [are] the dwellings of the perverse, and this the place [that] has not known God.
